summary: Frustrated: live fob flow skipped member confirmation
detailed_context: Nick added a fob after the v1.23.0 release and it went straight to programming instead of waiting for member confirmation. That was the core behaviour the release was meant to deliver, so this is a major miss on a shipped feature, and the assistant's summary had declared it live and working. The message is short and flat with no profanity, but it reports a functional failure rather than asking for more work, so it reads as clear frustration. Lesson: verify the confirmation gate end-to-end on the live flow before reporting a feature as live, and treat 'deployed' as not equal to 'behaving correctly'.
